items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1962-09-19
items.q: Well, no, I wouldn't be like him. Because that's just like, all right, can you name somebody a little lesser than Noel? He's the greatest.

ctx.x: But you know how Noel Coward gets into a taxi if he wants to compose? You got any special

gimmick? Well, no, I wouldn't be like him. Because that's just like, all right, can you name somebody a little lesser than Noel? He's the greatest. But you got any special gimmick for composing, or does it just happen? No, you know what? You don't need gimmick. If a tune keeps bothering you and it's on your mind, if you care, write music. Just get somebody to take it down for you. How about that, If We Never Meet Again? Is that yours? Well, with Goylach, I wrote that with a German boy that wrote Swing That Music…
When are you going to play that again? What?
